name: Extra Paragraph Types (EPT): Video
description: Adds single video (Remote videos and Local) paragraph type.
project_description: Extra Paragraph Types (EPT): Video ships a single 'EPT Video' Paragraphs bundle that references a core Media 'Remote Video' (oEmbed) entity and renders it, by default, as a clickable thumbnail that opens the video in a GLightbox overlay player. Per-paragraph presentation (margins/padding/border, background color/image/video, edge-to-edge, container width, additional classes, title tag) comes from the shared EPT design options provided by ept_core's field_ept_settings. The paragraph carries an optional title and body text alongside the video. It is one of the Extra Paragraph Types (EPT) family, all built on ept_core; install only the paragraph types you need. Requires core Media plus ept_core, paragraphs, glightbox and glightbox_media_video; installation is blocked until a 'Remote Video' media type exists.
